text:
Priya: Flagging discrepancy in cost-breakdown widget examples. PR #4190 updates the JS snippet but the property names no longer match SDK v2025.08. Live preview shows zeros for per-route cost. https://ci.redwood/docs/preview/4190
Tom: Saw that. The widget example uses `token_cost` while SDK now exposes `cost_per_token`. That's why totals are 0.
Priya: Repro: Console > Dashboards > Widgets > Cost Breakdown > example -> empty bars
Olivia: Ugh. Which files are affected? I can grep the repo but quick list would help.
Raj: I found three places: docs/console/widgets/cost-breakdown.md, examples/js/cost-widget.js, and playground-samples/cost-dashboard.json
Priya: Proposed short-term fix: update snippets to `cost_per_token` and add a migration note. Long-term: add a lightweight validation in docs-lint to catch unknown metric keys.
Tom: Agree on lint rule. Also add a changelog link to the widget page pointing to SDK changelog for v2025.08.
Olivia: I'll open a tiny PR to change examples and the markdown. PR title: "docs: align cost widget examples with SDK v2025.08"
Priya: Can you include a before/after snippet in the PR description? Example below: 
```
// before (broken)
const widget = {
  metricKey: 'token_cost',
  groupBy: ['route']
}
// after (fixed)
const widget = {
  metricKey: 'cost_per_token',
  groupBy: ['route']
}
```
Raj: Also add an owners line in docs header: `owners: docs, eng-platform` and a note: "If you see zero totals, check metricKey names vs SDK changelog"
Docs-bot: PR #4201 opened by Olivia: https://deploy.ci/redwood/pull/4201 
QA-bot: Quick preview run: docs-lint passed, but integration-test:widget-preview failed on playground-samples/cost-dashboard.json
Olivia: I'll patch the JSON sample too and run preview again.
Tom: For the migration guide: add a small table mapping old->new keys and note the date and SDK release. Example: `token_cost -> cost_per_token (v2025.08)`
Priya: Can we avoid changing server-side presets right now? I prefer patching docs only.
Raj: Agreed. If we end up with many docs changes, we can consider aliasing in SDK. I'll file an infra ticket to track that if needed.
Olivia: Updated PR with fixes and migration note, requesting review from @Priya and @Tom
Priya: Reviewing now, will post minor nits. :mag:
Tom: LGTM after nits. Please squash commits and add changelog link.
Docs-bot: PR #4201 merged and deployed to preview: https://deploy.ci/redwood/preview/4201
QA-bot: Preview check passed. Widget renders expected bars and tooltips show cost_per_token.
Priya: Closing loop. Follow-up: add docs-lint rule in a separate PR and schedule a quick post-mortem in next docs sync to discuss better SDK->docs coordination.
Raj: I'll add a checklist item to the docs PR template to run `playground-samples` preview locally before merging.
Olivia: Thanks everyone, learned a lot about catching SDK key renames earlier. :clap:
